propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently reuses the prior plan-review verdict computed under different scoring criteria, though ticket_type gates scoring in four distinct places affecting bug versus non-bug verdicts
The material_fingerprint basis excludes ticket_type, and both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) never compare stored versus current ticket_type when deciding to reuse a verdict
A ticket certified PASS as a bug (exempt from criteria) keeps that PASS when retyped to task (not exempt), replaying a verdict not computed under the current type's rules
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so no schema change is required to implement the guard; the data exists and must only be read during reuse decisions

The approach adds a type-comparison predicate to both reuse paths that returns None (triggering a full re-review) only when both stored and current types are truthy and differ, preserving reuse for sidecars written before the change
